name: PrefEval
description: PrefEval is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' ability to infer, memorize, and follow user preferences in long-context conversational settings. It contains 3,000 manually curated user preference and query pairs across 20 topics, assessing performance via generation and classification tasks to measure personalized preference following.
reputation: A newer benchmark for personalized preference following that has seen limited but growing use in long-context LLM evaluation.
notes: Evaluates preference following in multi-session conversations with long contexts; fine-tuning on PrefEval improves performance.
